$ yg check --json --top
exit: 1
--- stdout
--- stderr
Error: --top cannot be combined with --json.
--top narrows the TEXT report — fewer blocks, same counts. --json emits one machine document that always carries the whole run, so there is nothing for a narrowing flag to narrow, and a document trimmed to a few findings would read as a smaller problem instead of a smaller rendering.
Run: yg check --json (the whole run as a document), or yg check --top <n> (the narrowed text view).
